messages:
Aisha (Docs): FYI I found a cluster of small issues in the function/tool-calling + structured-output docs: inconsistent envelopes (`tool_output` vs `output`), TS/Python snippets out of sync with SDK rename, and one broken internal link. I'll open a tiny PR to standardize examples and add a compact migration shim.

Ravi (SDK): I can take the TS side. Which files should I patch?

Aisha (Docs): `docs/tool-calling.md`, `docs/structured-output.md`, `examples/ts/invoke-example.ts`. Also please add a short note about streaming vs non-streaming code paths.

Marta (Eng): I'll update the JSON schema examples to demonstrate `output` as the canonical envelope and add `additionalProperties: false`. Will include a minimal schema snippet and a one-line fallback pattern for legacy code.

Theo (DevEx): I'll refresh the runnable quickstart snippets and add a Python streaming example using `for chunk in resp.stream():`. Also will add a small runnable test in our docs CI that renders code blocks.

docs-bot: PR #8031 opened by @Aisha 03 https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8031 03 link-checker: 1 dead internal link.

Ravi (SDK): In TS snippet I will change `client.callTool(...)` -> `client.invoke(...)` and add an alias to preserve backward compatibility for older SDK users. I'll include both examples with clear headers.

Marta (Eng): Schema example to insert: { "type":"object","properties":{"output":{"type":"object","properties":{"result":{"type":"string"}},"required":["result"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["output"] }. Also adding migration note: "If you read `tool_output`, switch to `output` and validate shapes to catch regressions."

Aisha (Docs): For the docs text: keep canonical examples compact, then a short subsection "Legacy compatibility" showing the one-line shim: `result = resp.get('output') or resp.get('tool_output')`. Keep it simple.

Theo (DevEx): I'll add the streaming vs non-streaming comment: non-streaming `resp = client.invoke(...); print(resp['output']['result'])` vs streaming `for msg in client.invoke(..., stream=True): handle(msg)`.

Ravi (SDK): Reviewing now, left one small nit about import path in TS. Will update and push.

Aisha (Docs): Thanks all. After merge we'll deploy docs and Theo will open infra ticket for redirect from the old examples site. Target: merge tomorrow AM. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:

docs-bot: PR #8031 updated 03 CI: lint ok, link-checker now passes after patch.
